name: domsep-pneumatic-cannot-connect-to-generic-thermofluid
source:
COMPONENT PSink(in)
  PARAM P
  in.P = P
END
PneumaticSupply SUP(fluid$=Air, P=700000, T=300)
PSink           SNK(P=100000)
connect(SUP.out, SNK.in)

error.message: connect(sup.out, snk.in): cannot connect a 'gas' line (sup.out) to a 'fluid' line (snk.in). Thermofluid ('fluid'), liquid ('liquid'), two-phase ('twophase'), pneumatic ('gas'), hydraulic ('oil') and humid-air ('moistair') are incompatible fluid connector types; couple them only through a heat exchanger.
